question: Does an object-level quality mechanism shared across slots change vector-reference laws and calibration of the preserved nested statistic?
outcome: Three hundred fresh populations and 59,400 reference fits audited, with zero guarded states. At nominal 5%, broad vectors reject 12/300 (4%) and quality-conditioned vectors 9/300 (3%); paired difference one point, interval -1 to 3. Exact enumeration gives unequal broad-column probabilities and uniform quality-conditioned tables. Exact covariance calculations retain the stronger information in paired observations.
challenge: A wrong conditional law can have little measured separation under this prediction statistic. Main runtime was slower than the tiny pilot extrapolation.
remedy: Preserve the small main effect, fixed sample budget and actual runtime. Audit every proposal and sixteen fits, independently enumerate the laws and moments, and declare a separate fresh agreement-count sensitivity diagnostic.
retry_when: A new externally observed quality proxy or frozen statistic changes the specified observation/sensitivity question.
